ValidationRule.description: Blocks Closed Won above a 20% discount on Enterprise and Renewal deals until Approval_Status__c is Approved (Q15, Q16). Bypass: Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation, granted by Sales_Ops_Validation_Bypass. 0.20 not 20: Discount__c is Percent (D8).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Enterprise", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewal" ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), NOT(ISBLANK(Discount__c)), Discount__c > 0.20, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Approved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A discount above 20% needs manager approval before this opportunity can be Closed Won - submit for approval from the Discount panel.
